original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

# Append storage path for import
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agents/nova')

# Execute alignment script
subprocess.run([
    'python', 'storage/shared/agents/nova/align_with_cp_v2_5.py',
    'storage/shared/agents/nova/artifacts/consensus_adaptive_eval_77fa10bfaa.json',
    '--cp_index', 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/index_v2_5.json'
])

# Output confirmation
print("CP alignment completed: Summary TXT and annotated PNG generated in storage/shared/agents/nova/artifacts/")
